behavioralProtocol._instruction: Add all behavioral protocols that were performed during this session.

delayTime._instruction: Enter the arbitrary delay time set by user before each volume acquisition.

distorsion correction._instruction: Add the calibration file corresponding to images or field maps used for correction of inhomogeneities in B0 field of this acquisition.

motion correction._instruction: Add the calibration file used for motion correction, corresponding to single-band reference image, for this volume.

numberOfVolumesDiscardedByUser._instruction: Enter number of volumes discarded by user before the first volume.

registration data._instruction: Add the registration file corresponding to structural MRI relevant for this acquisition.

volumeTiming._instruction: Enter acquisition times of each vloume.
